headline: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol Challenges Proprietary Models in Professional Workloads
summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6.1 Sol, an enhanced version of its GPT-6 Astra model, offering competitive performance at a lower cost. This shift is challenging proprietary models and accelerating local AI agent deployment.
whyItMatters: It broadens access to advanced reasoning capabilities and reduces developer dependence on expensive closed platforms.
